message.content:
Answer: B
Reason: The ultrasound images show a fetal lung mass composed of numerous small cysts (microcystic appearance) with no evidence of a systemic feeding vessel on color Doppler, which is characteristic of Congenital Cystic Adenomatoid Malformation (CCAM/CPAM) Type II. Type I typically presents with large macrocysts (>2 cm), and pulmonary sequestration would demonstrate a systemic arterial supply.
